items.headline: Landyn Locke throws 4 TDs as Sam Houston picks up 1st win of season with 59-0 win over Nicholls
items.description: — Landyn Locke threw for 322 yards and four touchdowns as Sam Houston shut out Nicholls 59-0 on Saturday for its first win of the season.

items.description: — Trequan Jones ran for 125 yards and scored twice, Tulsa took the lead for good early in the third quarter and went the Golden Hurricane went on to beat Sam Houston 23-17 on Saturday.
